article_context: The body image illustrates the memorable wildlife encounter on the easy family ecotrail: seeing Karachay horses grazing freely amid Arkhyz’s summer mountain meadows, reinforcing the route as an experience to enjoy rather than rush through.
image_reading: A scattered herd of dark horses and several foals grazes on a steep green meadow covered with yellow wildflowers.
Most animals have their heads lowered; the herd extends diagonally across the slope, while one brown horse stands alert near the upper right.
The horses can naturally crop grass, shift weight, flick tails and take small steps without changing the pastoral composition.

models.positive_prompt: The herd grazes calmly, taking slow uphill steps as heads sweep through the grass; tails flick gently and the foals stay close. Fixed camera. By the final frames, several horses have advanced a few paces while the whole herd remains peacefully grazing in view.
models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed wide shot. Grazing begins immediately and continues at an even, moderate pace: several horses crop the grass and take one or two small uphill steps, with restrained tail flicks and foals remaining near the adults. The diagonal herd formation stays recognizable. Near the end, the animals settle into newly shifted positions with heads still lowered and the entire herd visible.

models.positive_prompt: The horses graze steadily across the slope, drifting a few steps uphill while their heads move through the grass and tails sway lightly. Keep the camera fixed; end with the herd still spread across the meadow, calmly feeding in slightly advanced positions.
models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for a continuous, gentle grazing drift. Different visible horses take small, naturally staggered steps uphill while feeding; slight tail movement supports the same pastoral process. Hold a fixed camera so the herd’s scale and diagonal arrangement remain clear. The endpoint is a subtly advanced but still scattered herd, all remaining calm and engaged in grazing.

models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, the herd calmly grazes and shifts a few short steps uphill; heads sweep through the grass and a few tails flick. End with the horses and foals still fully visible, peacefully feeding in their new positions.
models.scene_plan: Compress the focused moment into four seconds with smaller amplitude. The herd begins grazing motion at once; a few horses make short uphill steps while continuing to feed, accompanied by sparse tail flicks. The camera remains fixed. By the last frame, the animals occupy slightly shifted positions but preserve the tranquil wild-herd tableau and remain fully visible.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A chance encounter with free-grazing Karachay horses makes a family walk through Arkhyz’s summer meadows emotionally memorable.
structured_intent.primary_action: The herd continues grazing while gradually moving across the slope.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The horses remain a calm, freely grazing herd in the mountain meadow, preserving the sense of a peaceful wildlife encounter.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The horses and foals remain spread across the meadow in slightly advanced positions, still calmly grazing.
